propositions: Expose typed public library functions (bridge_preview, bridge_sync, bridge_status, bridge_pause, bridge_resume, bridge_check_access) reusing the canonical run_pass() / _Disposition seam without duplicating route/exit-code tables.
Register new bridge operations as MCP tools with explicit typed inputs, no mode parameter, and output schemas while preserving existing reconcile(mode=...) and bridge_fsck tool names and contracts.

Legacy library rebar.reconcile(mode=...) and MCP reconcile tool retain their published signatures, defaults, return types, exception behavior, and mutation boundaries; compatibility adapters map to new bridge operations without silent alias changes.

Extract a result-bearing typed helper beneath run_pass() that returns _Disposition and structured pass detail before _finish_disposition() collapses to integer, enabling shared reuse by library and MCP adapters.

Every mutating new and legacy MCP route (bridge_sync, bridge_pause, bridge_resume, reconcile modes) is gated by mcp.allow_jira_sync; preview, status, fsck, and access-check remain callable as read-only operations.
New MCP tools publish output schemas, maintain parity with models/types/generated references, and pass schema-coverage checks; existing compatibility schemas remain valid after registration.
